breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction between the specified Dirichlet boundary conditions and the additional request for periodic boundaries. It resolved this by keeping the detailed Dirichlet conditions and explicitly stating, 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions and do not identify endpoints.' This matches the ground truth, which removed the periodic condition entirely.
